subject: Scheduled export not delivering to email
body: Hi, we have a scheduled export set to run every Monday morning and deliver to three addresses. It ran fine until two weeks ago but has not delivered since the 15th. The export shows as 'completed' in the log but nothing arrives. I have checked spam folders on all three accounts. Could you investigate what's happening on your end? Regards, Ingrid Dahl

subject: Alert threshold not triggering correctly
body: Hello, I noticed that one of our margin alerts did not fire last week even though the value crossed the threshold we set. I checked the configuration and it appears correct — threshold at 12%, notify when below, email delivery. The value dropped to 10.8% on Wednesday and no alert was sent. We rely on these for month-end review, so I would like to understand whether this is a configuration issue or a platform bug. Thanks, Ingrid Dahl

subject: Dashboard filters not persisting between sessions
body: We have several dashboards where users set date range and entity filters. These do not persist when the user logs out and back in. I understand this may be by design, but it creates extra steps for our team every morning. Is there a setting to save filter state per user? If not, is this something on the roadmap? Ingrid Dahl

subject: API returning 429 errors intermittently
body: We are getting intermittent 429 responses from the data pull endpoint, even when our call volume is well within what we understood to be the rate limit. Our integration runs every 30 minutes with roughly 40 calls per batch. This started around the same time as the dashboard filter issue I reported last week — I don't know if they are related. The errors are blocking our downstream pipeline. This is becoming disruptive. Ingrid Dahl

subject: Report builder crashing on save
body: Report builder is crashing when I try to save. Tried twice, same result. Need this fixed today — year-end reporting. Ingrid Dahl

subject: Alerts still not reliable — same issue as September
body: We had an alert configuration problem back in September (ticket from that time). It was supposedly resolved, but we have now seen two more missed alerts this quarter. I am documenting the dates: 14 April, threshold crossed at 11.2%, no alert. 28 April, same alert, no trigger. The configuration has not changed. I would like someone to actually look at the alert engine logic rather than just telling me to reconfigure. Ingrid Dahl

subject: Dashboard loading times unacceptable
body: Our main financial dashboard is taking 45–60 seconds to load. This is not workable. We have raised the filter persistence issue before, the alert issues are still open, and now basic dashboard performance is broken. I need someone senior to look at our account. Ingrid Dahl

subject: Export output truncated — rows missing
body: Export is truncated again. Missing rows. Ingrid Dahl

subject: Export truncation still happening
body: The export truncation from last week is still happening. New export run today, same problem — 1,847 rows in the file, 2,300+ expected. This is the same issue, not resolved. Ingrid Dahl

subject: Formula reference broken after report duplication
body: When duplicating a report, calculated field references break and display as errors. We have found a workaround — rebuilding the formulas manually in the copy — so this is not blocking us, but it does add time each quarter when we set up new versions of standard reports. Please log this as a bug. Ingrid Dahl

subject: API documentation gap — pagination for /metrics endpoint
body: The /metrics endpoint documentation does not describe pagination behavior. From testing we have determined that results are capped at 500 rows but there is no next_page token or offset parameter documented. We have worked around this by batching our date ranges, but wanted to flag the documentation gap. Ingrid Dahl

subject: Dashboard slow again

subject: API throwing 500s since this morning

subject: Report builder template sharing

subject: Dashboard shows different totals than underlying report

subject: Dashboard data discrepancy still not resolved

This is causing confusion in our reporting meetings. We need this properly resolved, not approximated. Ville Larsson

subject: Widget tooltips showing wrong date
body: Hover tooltips on line chart widgets are showing the wrong date — they are one day off from the actual data point. Small thing but it creates confusion when users are trying to check values. Pekka Lund

subject: API — missing fields in /connectors response
body: The /connectors endpoint is returning connection status but not the 'last_sync_time' field that the documentation describes. We are using this field to build our own monitoring. When was this field removed and is it coming back? This is blocking our integration work. Ville Larsson

subject: Report scheduler sending to wrong recipients

This appears to have started after the platform update two weeks ago. One of the recipients getting incorrect reports has escalated internally. Please treat with urgency. Pekka Lund

subject: Large export timing out

subject: Report scheduler issue — is this the same bug as July?

We have open tickets on the scheduler, the API, and now this. At what point does someone senior review our account? Pekka Lund

subject: Alert rule duplication feature request
